name: iotevents
description: AWS IoT Events monitors your equipment or device fleets for failures or changes in operation, and triggers actions when such events occur.

subcommands.name: create-alarm-model
subcommands.description: Creates an alarm model to monitor an AWS IoT Events input attribute.

options.name: --alarm-model-name
options.description: A unique name that helps you identify the alarm model.

options.name: --alarm-model-description
options.description: A description that tells you what the alarm model detects

options.name: --role-arn
options.description: The ARN of the IAM role that allows the alarm to perform actions and access AWS resources.

options.name: --tags
options.description: A list of key-value pairs that contain metadata for the alarm model.

options.name: --key
options.description: An input attribute used as a key to create an alarm.

options.name: --severity
options.description: A non-negative integer that reflects the severity level of the alarm

options.name: --alarm-rule
options.description: Defines when your alarm is invoked

options.name: --alarm-notification
options.description: Contains information about one or more notification actions

options.name: --alarm-event-actions
options.description: Contains information about one or more alarm actions

options.name: --alarm-capabilities
options.description: Contains the configuration information of alarm state changes

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
